purpose: engineering_candidate; not historical experiment reproduction or validation-selected winner
fit_population: split_indices.json fit_ids only; sorted by segment; no val/test fitting
parameter_source: historical fusion.json selection; transferred fixed k/c/gate mapping; no new-feature search; historical validation winner was soft_perchannel

rules.comparison: strict outside; sigma OR IQR counts each feature once
